title: Truthful · Product design and execution review
capturePolicy: Use actual app states and synthetic records. Specified frames are a design plan; this file does not assert that a Figma file or native layers have already been created.

sections.title: Truthful · OVO
sections.headline: Follow the promise to the invoice.
sections.body: Review outstanding credits, inspect the supporting evidence, and make the next financial decision with the original terms intact.
sections.label: All examples and counterparties are synthetic.

sections.title: The job to be done
sections.headline: Recover what is owed without buying a worse deal.
sections.body: A finance lead needs to distinguish a promise from applied value, see the economic cost of changed terms, and keep yesterday’s permission from authorizing today’s action.
sections.persona: Finance operator reviewing vendor concessions and renewals.
sections.trigger: A promised credit only partly reaches the invoice; the reply adds a renewal condition.
sections.desiredOutcome: A source-backed outstanding balance, a deliberate terms decision, a current exact approval, and an inspectable local action record.

sections.title: The anchor case
sections.headline: $2,400 promised → $900 applied → $1,500 open
sections.body: Fictional Pipeline CRM. Its contingent $1,500 benefit carries $2,400 of incremental renewal spend against the explicit same-horizon baseline: −$900 net incremental value. Preserving original terms does not create applied savings.
sections.label: Illustrative USD values from the authored case; no customer result or ROI claim.

sections.title: One review ritual, explicit boundaries
sections.headline: Evidence → portfolio → exact approval → bounded stress test → scoped grant → local effect → pinned-root verification
sections.body: Evidence import and portfolio-copy exploration are connected. The authority lab is currently Pipeline-focused. Browser signing uses an isolated ephemeral workspace; it does not sign the browser portfolio. An arbitrary selected-case handoff is shown only as a concept.

sections.title: The visual system
sections.headline: Clarity before complexity.
sections.body: Ramp-inspired efficiency and Apple-inspired hierarchy: one clear next action, financial context beside the decision, and technical detail when it is needed.
components: Numbered execution trace and selected transition
Receipt and explicitly pinned trust root
Warning, error, not-run and inconclusive states
principles: Make the amount, status and next action easy to find.
Use compact records and keep related evidence together.
Reveal advanced detail on demand; retain exact approval boundaries.

sections.title: What success establishes
sections.headline: A current-state check and a signed history have different jobs.
sections.body: The local boundary rechecks current authority before committing its effect. Offline verification checks included signed history against a separately trusted issuer. It cannot establish current revocation, global unspentness, authentic vendor evidence, source completeness, organizational identity, or external settlement.
sections.label: No live LLM, inbox, Ramp, vendor, or payment connection. No AP2/UCP/MCP/A2A or IETF-draft conformance claim.

sections.title: The next useful steps
sections.headline: Connect the case; validate the outcome.
sections.body: The concept stage unifies case identity across review, model analysis and authority. A later pilot would add authenticated source intake, organizational roles, narrowly permissioned adapters and independently labeled operator cases. These require implementation and evaluation; dates, integrations and outcomes are not promised.
implemented: Supported text/CSV evidence reconciliation and exact source spans
Atomic evidence promotion into the financial portfolio
Current exact-action approval and versioned terms
Bounded authored/custom plan exploration and contained current-portfolio copies
Fixed repairs for five unchanged authored families
Real Ed25519 scope, agent possession, narrowed child delegation and one-use local execution
concept: Arbitrary selected-case handoff into the authority lab
Organizational identity and managed key custody
Independent pilot evaluation and protocol-conformance work

sections.title: Finance work architecture
sections.headline: The next financial job leads the workspace.
sections.body: Operations prioritizes actual exceptions. Vendor, source, activity and report views all project the same recorded ledger.
rows: Operations
Deadlines, conflicting terms, stale approvals and unused capacity.
Vendor record
Commitments, physical credit lines and exact source revisions.
Evidence and activity
What was supplied, which revision was used, who recorded the change.
Reports
Explicit financial and knowledge cutoffs; contingent value remains separate.

sections.title: Credit fulfillment journey
sections.headline: Issued → attributed → applied → precisely reversed.
sections.body: A $350 promise receives a $300 memo. $100 is attributed first; $200 remains available. Application does not create another physical credit.
rows: Issued memo
No verified applied value until invoice evidence exists.
Partial attribution
One line, one conserved balance across commitments.
Invoice application
Use a separate invoice source on the existing credit identity.
Causal reversal
Remove $50 and $100 from exact attributions; $150 remains verified.

sections.title: Changed terms and authority
sections.headline: A proposal is evidence. Acceptance is a separate decision.
sections.body: Amount, schedule, conditions and renewal economics stay inspectable against the original agreement.
rows: Analyst
Record the source, amendment proposal and exact review action together.
Approver
Approve the exact current action under the mandate and source basis.
Executor
Record approved terms once; new evidence can invalidate old permission.
Outcome
Original $350 retained. Accepted promise $400; verified $150; $250 remains.

sections.title: Ambiguous credit handoff
sections.headline: Clarification precedes assignment.
sections.body: A shared reference does not imply ownership. No operator may silently guess which commitment receives a credit.
rows: Analyst evidence
Record a clarification source without assigning financial ownership.
Approver limits
Choose the exact revision and explicit maximum for each candidate.
Conservation
Limits cannot exceed available credit or erase active attribution.
Release
Quarantine can clear. Attribution and invoice application remain separate jobs.

sections.title: Operational state coverage
sections.headline: The exception is part of the product.
sections.body: Forms explain required evidence, role, current basis, duplicate identity, date and capacity before the final effect.
rows: Empty and loading
A useful next action without fabricated records or applied value.
Role and history
Adjacent reasons explain why a write is unavailable.
Stale and conflicting
Discard old previews; preserve documents and incompatible proposals.
Failure and recovery
Atomic refusal keeps the draft; explicit retry checks current state.

sections.title: Responsive handoff
sections.headline: Keep the decision intact at every width.
sections.body: Desktop pairs records and evidence; mobile gives the selected task a continuous single-column reading order.
rows: 1440px desktop
Compact rail, selected record, source controls and financial preview.
900px intermediate
Filters and facts wrap without moving essential actions off the work surface.
390px mobile
Real record selection, stacked fields, clear totals and 44px actions.
Keyboard
Visible focus, native fields and disclosures, deliberate source-to-case returns.

sections.title: Implementation and design evidence
sections.headline: A native design is editable. A working journey is executable.
sections.body: Both artifacts are verified separately. A screen link is never evidence that a financial command ran.
rows: Application
Actual reducer, SQLite/browser persistence and exported evidence.
Native Figma
Editable text, auto-layout, linked components, shared styles and prototype destinations.
Verification
Original root identities retained; explicit expansion manifest; reviewed current exports.
Trust limits
Synthetic supplied evidence. No issuer authentication, live model, vendor contact or settlement.

actions.label: Review claim draft
actions.note:
Review the exact original-terms draft and its citations before recording claim approval. Approval is local and sends no email; it does not approve a portfolio action.
Alternate blocked state: The matched invoice credits fully cover the promise. No outstanding credit remains to claim. Review the matched invoices. You can add the completed record to the portfolio.
Conditional or changed replies remain excluded from portfolio import. Resolve the terms with supporting evidence before importing. Approval of an original-terms follow-up does not accept the condition.

annotations: $2,400 promised, $900 verified applied, $1,500 outstanding.
Exact reference PC-SEATS-2026 outranks an amount-only match.
The citation quote and character offsets come from the supplied text; they do not authenticate the vendor.
Claim approval is distinct from an action approval; downloading EML sends no message.
The next-step panel gives the exact reason and next step for unsupported, conditional, future-due, fully applied and empty-draft states; disabled buttons do not substitute for an explanation.
Portfolio import retains its own boundary. An original-terms draft approval does not accept changed terms or authorize a portfolio action.

screens.purpose: Separate recoverable, applied, issued and conditional value; retain lineage.
screens.entry: Assurance → Portfolio, Pipeline selected, Evidence graph tab.

actions.label: Shared ledger
actions.note: Alternate case information tab; conserves the shared credit balance.

actions.label: Workspace options
actions.note: Closed by default. Explore the mechanism, export the audit packet, and inspect the selectable demo role here. Reset requires an explicit confirmation in the app. Browser workspace has no server authority; Local SQLite enforces roles at its boundary. This prototype note changes no role, record or workspace.

actions.label: Review next action
actions.note: Open the existing original-terms action for the currently selected commitment. Imported commitments prepare and review their own action; they never fall back to the authored Pipeline action.

annotations: Use the authored Pipeline case for the main review sequence; imported cases retain their own identity.
Sources → commitment/terms → ledger → action/approval are real recorded relationships.
Effective on and Known by are separate historical controls; historical views disable writes.
Issued credit and an approved local action are excluded from verified applied savings.
Workspace options is a closed utility disclosure; the portfolio summary and selected-case next action remain primary.
Guided cases, Demo activity and Demo sources belong to a separate Guided demo group. They are not imported shared-portfolio records.
Imported-case continuity: select that commitment, review its own original claim, approve with an allowed demo role and record locally. No email, payment or connected vendor effect is implied.

screens.title: 04 · Expose the cost of the offer
screens.purpose: Explain why a nominal credit can have negative incremental value.

actions.label: Pipeline CRM · Preserve original terms
actions.note: Select the existing preserve-original action in the decision queue.

actions.label: Change the comparison assumptions
actions.note: Expand explicit what-if fields; this does not change a proposal.

annotations: Contingent credit $1,500; incremental renewal cost $2,400; net incremental value −$900.
Keep the explicit baseline visible; do not call the remaining credit free money.
A later vendor proposal changes no accepted terms until an exact approved acceptance takes effect.
Record a reason when dismissing a conflicting alternative; never silently delete its history.

screens.purpose: Make the scope of a finance review inspectable.
screens.entry: Decision room → Pipeline Preserve original terms; inspect the exact bound evidence revisions.

actions.label: Approve exact action
actions.note: State changes from Needs approval to Approved when current policy permits. Alternate analyst state: Requires approver or admin role. Current role: analyst. Historical view is read only. Return to latest records to make changes. After approval, Record approved action still needs executor or admin; no external transaction is performed.

actions.label: Execution lab
actions.note: Navigate, then select the approved action under Current approved portfolio actions.

actions.label: Return to commitment

actions.label: Original duplicate-seat correction · revision 6
actions.note:
Recorded source: pipeline-promise@6 · email.
SYNTHETIC ASSURANCE EXAMPLE
We will credit USD 2,400 on your October 1, 2026 invoice for duplicate seats. Reference PC-SEATS-2026. This correction does not require a renewal.

annotations: Analysis copies the approved action, exact approval basis, recorded sources and explicit simulation time.

screens.title: 07 · Inspect the unsafe effect
screens.purpose: Show a concrete shortest retained prefix and the same-schedule guarded rejection.
screens.entry: Run the portfolio source-revision adversary and select the final unsafe-effect step.

actions.label: Replay report
actions.note: Verify contained state, trace, search counts and result.

annotations: The source-revision portfolio witness has three modeled steps: check, revision, commit.
The naive cached-check reference is a teaching harness, not a competitor or LLM benchmark.
Name the portfolio snapshot and show when live state has changed after it.
A portable replay verifies its supplied model premises, not authentic evidence or approval identity.

Alternate working-app interaction: selecting Current effect boundary displays the same-schedule guarded replay and its STALE_APPROVAL refusal. This review frame shows that refusal directly; its verdict panel is not a prototype hotspot.

Alternate working-app setup: switch to the unchanged authored Two consumers, one credit family, rerun, then choose Inspect repaired plan. The repair frame documents that distinct state; no portfolio-copy automatic repair or direct family-switch hotspot is implied.

screens.title: 08 · Preserve uncertainty at the bound
screens.purpose: Show resource exhaustion as an honest incomplete result.
screens.entry: Authored Two consumers, one credit → ten-state budget → Explore schedules.

actions.label: State budget: 2,000 states
actions.note: Increase budget and rerun the authored family; inspect its repaired plan.

annotations: Amber Inconclusive: search limit is separate from green No unsafe effect within bounds.
Display depth/state/transition/time bounds and retained frontier/cutoff facts.
Do not show a cutoff as proof that the workflow is safe.
Completion counts and unsafe-effect counts answer different questions.

screens.title: 09 · A permitted continuation
screens.purpose: Demonstrate a concrete repair that still completes the declared goal.
screens.entry: Authored Two consumers, one credit → 2,000-state run → Inspect repaired plan.
annotations: Atomic current-state allocation preserves both distinct command/intent IDs; it does not merge them.
The first credit allocation consumes $900 capacity; another allocation cannot consume it again.
Show safe terminal completion separately from blocked attempts.
Five unchanged authored families have fixed repairs; edited, portfolio-copy and unknown plans get no invented repair.
The deadline repair intentionally blocks an expired ordering; it does not extend authority.

actions.note: Approve the new Pipeline preserve-original action.

actions.note: Available once the current action is approved.

annotations: The current UI is Pipeline preserve-original focused; arbitrary selected-action handoff is a concept.

screens.title: 11 · Issue only the required scope
screens.purpose: Make limits, lifetime, identity binding and attenuation visible.
screens.entry: Approved signing-lab Pipeline action → claim limit USD 1,500 → lifetime 120 seconds → Issue signed grant.

actions.label: Delegate to worker
actions.note: Optional child uses a fresh key and cannot widen action, audience, amount, obligation or parent lifetime.

actions.label: Revoke root grant
actions.note: Refuses new uses under the root and its children.

actions.label: Revise supporting source
actions.note: Invalidates the old approval basis; a signature cannot revive it.

annotations: Use a grant snapshot captured before expiry; the visible expiry is a recorded value, not a countdown promise.
Maximum new obligation is $0; action/workspace/audience and full approval digest remain bound.
Ed25519 is real cryptography under a custom Truthful profile.
The ephemeral agent private key stays in memory; an embedded issuer key is not automatically trusted.

screens.title: 12 · Recheck and record once
screens.purpose: Explain the difference between one effect and a harmless retry.
screens.entry: Use a valid fresh signing-lab grant before expiry → Record delegated action.

actions.label: Retry identical request
actions.note: Returns the earlier signed receipt and records no second effect.

actions.label: Attempt another execution
actions.note: A fresh use of the consumed root is refused.

annotations: The local boundary verifies issuer/signature, agent possession, exact current action/basis, policy, limits, lifetime and revocation.
SQLite commits the financial effect, consumed root nonce, audit, receipt and retry response together.
The preserve-original action changes local action state; it does not apply credit, send a message or settle a payment.
Receipt revision and ID come from the actual record; do not invent fingerprints or receipt identifiers.

screens.title: 13 · Trust deliberately; verify the record
screens.purpose: Show independent trust and detectable tampering without overstating offline evidence.
screens.entry: Export signed evidence → Download public trust key separately → Pin this demo issuer → Verify signed packet.

actions.label: Verify signed packet
actions.note: Unpinned issuer is refused; explicit trusted issuer enables recorded-history verification.

actions.label: Alter checkpoint signature
actions.note: Reverify to show a named rejection rather than a success badge.

annotations: No issuer is trusted until explicitly pinned; pinning a demo key establishes no real organization’s identity.
Verification checks included signed lifecycle/grants/requests, checkpoint and the recorded reducer effect.
It cannot prove current revocation, global unspentness, source authenticity/completeness or external settlement.
Offline success is evidence about the recorded checkpoint, never permission for another execution.

annotations: CONCEPT — retain a visible concept label in the frame and prototype hotspot.
Carry immutable case/action identity, workspace identity, source/approval basis and analysis report digest.
Rerun eligibility at issue and execute; a successful exploration report never grants authority.
Do not imply that browser-local portfolio records are already signed by the isolated browser issuer.
